source_record.inference: The explicit contribution is material at its stated guard even when final action is confirmed rather than changed. Corresponding mechanisms may overlap; duplicate names, reused tests and common pipelines do not create additional benefit or independence.
attempted_contrary_interfaces: Identical test behavior treated as unique artifact identity.
A green pipeline treated as exposure authority.
An approved model treated as actual deployed state.
The same test counted as independent evidence twice.
All evidence discarded after harmless change.
All evidence carried after a changed critical premise.
A trace link treated as proof of the linked claim.

positive_controls.argument: Explicit candidate readiness and distinct deployment/exposure states supply current release knowledge that prevents a staged artifact being misreported as authorized operation.
A reproducible packaged candidate and visible readiness status provide distinct configuration references for technical preparation and later exposure.
Keeping deployment distinct from exposure makes it possible to examine the prepared artifact and its environment before the exposure decision.
Separated candidate and exposure states permit a verified change to be held while consequential approval or evidence is obtained.
A reproducible candidate exposes the proposed interface version and permits compatibility testing before user exposure.
A stable candidate and explicit readiness conditions make the proposed test article and unsatisfied evidence needs visible before exposure.
A reproducible candidate supplies a stable article for the relevant integration levels and prevents a changing branch from obscuring test attribution.
The explicit candidate and exposure state supply configuration-specific endpoints for release evidence and outstanding conditions.
Separating technical preparation from exposure prevents an evidence-producing pipeline from silently becoming the risk-accepting authority.
A distinct candidate and exposure status let the release be held or bounded without erasing unresolved defects from the prepared artifact.
The reproducible packaged candidate supplies an executable reference for checking whether model and release views describe the same proposed realization.
The readiness/exposure separation supplies a receiving boundary at which continuous evidence can inform a candidate decision without automatically deploying to users.
